date:before-the-flood@186f44.note: Timing is the sum of Genesis ages (5.32, 7.6, 7.11); the BC years rest on outside chronology (Ussher), not the text.

date:flood-and-nations@525875.note: Gen 11.10 puts Arphaxad two years after the flood; 11.26 has Terah 70 when he begets Abram. The BC years depend on outside dating (Ussher-style), not the text.

lede:before-the-flood@9beb2b.note: Gen 1.1, 2.8, 3.6 and 3.23 support creation, Eden, sin and exile; 6.7 and 6.13 the flood. The children-filling-earth-with-violence step is inferred from 6.1 and 6.11.

lede:flood-and-nations@814175.note: Verses state Noah's family entering and leaving the ark, God remembering Noah, the no-more-flood covenant, nations divided after the flood, and the scattering at Babel.
